verdict.rationale: Elastic's hybrid search docs say full-text and vector search run in one request and return a single ranked list. They recommend fusing the two rankings with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and `semantic_text` fields generate the embeddings automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid query behavior, concrete query syntax or retriever examples in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hybrid search — semantic vector similarity fused with keyword matching — in a single query

citations.quote: Hybrid search runs full-text search and vector search in one request... you return one ranked list that combines keyword matching with similarity search.
We recommend implementing hybrid search with the reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) algorithm. This approach merges rankings from the full-text and vector queries
When you index content into a `semantic_text` field, Elasticsearch automatically generates vector embeddings using a configured machine learning model and stores them in the underlying vector field.
